documentation: Each rule rewrites a thumbnail URL into its full-resolution original. Rules are tried before the generic rules in src/core/upgrade-rules.js, in array order, and every produced URL is HEAD-verified before it is offered unless `verify` is false. Fields: match (hostname or suffix, `*` for any), path (optional regex the pathname must satisfy), find (regex applied to the whole URL), replace (replacement, $1..$9 supported), verify (default true), note (shown in the panel).

rules.note: Wikimedia: drop /thumb/ and the rendition segment
Wikipedia: drop /thumb/ and the rendition segment
Reddit: preview.redd.it renditions have an i.redd.it original
Jetpack Photon: drop every resize parameter
Squarespace: ask for the original rendition
Shopify: strip the named size suffix
Amazon: strip the ._SX300_ style transform block
GitHub avatars: request the largest served size
